qualification_review.interpretation: The shared course depends on cross-campus accessibility handoffs, bounded faculty workload, viable enrollment, and room or network continuity.
qualification_review.limitations: The operations sheet assigns responses but cannot guarantee that incidents or enrollment changes will not occur.

records.interpretation: The coordinator begins trying to preserve advanced Korean instruction by combining low-enrollment campus sections while maintaining valid credit and local support.
records.limitations: This captures the initial academic and administrative pressure before approval.

records.interpretation: The colleges approve one shared course with a common instructor and syllabus, campus sections, local conversation groups, accessibility handoffs, workload and enrollment rules, room responses, a census transfer formula, and dated program reviews.
records.limitations: The approval covers the coming academic year and retains separate responsibilities across the three colleges.

records.interpretation: Technology incidents, accessibility needs, low site enrollment, and workload observations follow the named campus responses and scheduled dean reviews.
records.limitations: The program may be revised or ended at the December meeting based on the specified evidence.
